description: Report the location nodes of the site (cvrt-seo-manager 1.18.0+, feature locations; refused with a clear message on an older plugin): the LocalBusiness node and findings of every published location post without a password, all languages. Returns { enabled, post_type, total, locations: [{ post_id, language, url, node, findings }] }; enabled false and no locations while the module is off (seo_update_settings local_seo.locations).
name: seo_locations_report
